summary: The PR changed idSchema to accept only canonical decimal ids within the int4 range, and added MAX_TODO_ID. I added cases for non-canonical ids, ids above the range, and the maximum id to validators.test.ts. The typecheck passes, but I could not run the tests: Vitest failed to start because the installed @vitest/coverage-v8 package has a corrupt package.json.

behaviours: rejects ids like 0x10, 1e3, +5, 012, empty string and leading space
rejects 2147483648, one above the int4 maximum
targets.reason: The new canonical-id regex and int4 upper bound were untested. I added cases next to the existing id tests and left the existing assertions unchanged.

findings.detail: The run-tests script exited with code 2. Vitest reported ERR_INVALID_PACKAGE_CONFIG (Unexpected end of JSON input) and 'Cannot find dependency @vitest/coverage-v8'. The package.json appears truncated or corrupt in this environment, so the new tests have not been run. Reinstalling dependencies should fix it.
